msg: The pilot in command, not ATC, is ultimately responsible for avoiding collisions (SERA.3201); the Rules of the Air book key gets this wrong.
House rule: 30 ft per hPa is the primary figure; give 27 ft only in brackets as the more precise value.
Keeping a line feature on the left is a CAA recommendation, no longer a legal requirement under SERA.
OVER and OUT are not normally used on VHF (CAP 413).
